race.comment: MAGNETIC EDGE (3) kept coming only to just miss last start over 2121m at Gawler, his second placing in a row. He's an 11yo veteran who finds a very winnable race here and can notch up another in. TEE EIGHT (7) did his best work late and finished 3 lengths from the winner in fifth last start over 2121m at Gawler, not far behind MAGNETIC EDGE. Draws better this time and can atone. AHVEJAY (1) has been in the market at his last couple of runs but failed to threaten, the latest effort a modest ninth at Mt Gambier over 1550m. Up in trip now and could improve. LANDMARK ALLEY (11) finished in the money last start running third at Gawler and should strip fitter for past attempts. In the mix.
